title: Proof Manifest Spec
description: Input shape for scripts/proof_manifest_audit.mjs — a normalized description of a PR's visual-evidence artifacts, their provenance manifests, and (for control-panel PRs) the required-state coverage they demonstrate.

branchCommit.description: The PR branch's current HEAD commit SHA. Every artifact manifest's "commit" field is checked against this value.

isControlPanelPr.description: True if this PR changes the operator control-panel surface (GPUI/console/dashboard) and must therefore clear full required-state coverage.

statesCovered.description: Which of the required control-panel proof states this PR's artifact set demonstrates. Only checked when isControlPanelPr is true, but always validated for shape.

artifacts.description: Every proof artifact (screenshot, GIF, recording) attached to the PR, each with its provenance manifest. Empty is legal input but always fails the audit (no-artifacts).

file.description: Path (or SHA-pinned raw URL) of the artifact, e.g. .github/assets/661/control-panel-active-stream.gif.

manifest.description: Provenance manifest binding the artifact to a real daemon-backed run. Pass {} for an artifact that truly carries no manifest yet — the audit will name every missing field.

daemonPort.description: The Port Daddy-allocated daemon port the artifact's daemon-backed flow ran against.

runId.description: The run identifier of the agent session captured in the artifact.

transcriptHeadHash.description: Hash of the transcript HEAD at capture time, proving the artifact matches a specific point in the real event stream.

agentNodeId.description: The agent node id whose session is depicted.

commit.description: The commit the artifact was captured against. Must equal branchCommit or the artifact is stale/reused proof.

sourceLabel.description: Honest declaration of what produced the artifact's data. "fixture"/"mock" are allowed — undeclared is not.
